metadata_coverage.comments_note: No cached issue or PR review comment counts exist; null means not measured, never zero.

field_semantics.contributor_count: GitHub contributors endpoint anon=false: non-anonymous contributors, not commit count; capped counts remain unknown
field_semantics.issue_comment_count: Issue conversation comments, not PR review comments or commits
field_semantics.pr_review_comment_count: Pull-request review comments, not issue conversation comments or commits

metadata_coverage.join: Exact case-insensitive repository name with one cached GitHub ID; provider IDs are not GitHub IDs. Renames or reused names can invalidate cross-source identity; no rename continuity is inferred.
metadata_coverage.rights: Public GitHub repository metadata retains its owners' rights; not relicensed by GitTrend aggregate-data terms. Descriptions and topics are untrusted text.
metadata_coverage.source: Prior GitHub API metadata observations; not a published complete star snapshot
